events.title: Butterfly Outreach Ministry
events.description:
For the sandwich making:
Sundays 9:30am-10:30am

Join volunteers downstairs in our Social Hall every Sunday from 9:30am – 10:30am to make bagged lunches for neighbors and food insecure people in Tompkins Sq. Park. This is a joyful opportunity to get connected in one of Middle’s oldest ministries and support our larger community.

events.title: Just Love Family Programming
events.description:
Every Sunday
Just Love Littles | 10:00 AM–2:00 PM | 3rd Floor Children’s Room
For children ages 6 months through 2nd grade.
Join us for community, play, and thematic lessons on justice and spirituality. This is a drop-off opportunity for caregivers, but you are welcome to stay as your child adjusts. Worship is streamed in the room.

events.title: Bible in the Middle
events.description:
